title: Data sources page shows zero sources while seven connectors run

root_cause.defect: Previously checked `if v2_sources is not None and (len(v2_sources) > 0 or client_error is None):`. Because `v2_sources` is non-None whenever `client_error is None`, an empty v2 store (`v2_sources == []`) entered the v2 branch and returned HTTP 200 with `meta.status="ok"`, `meta.source="service_client"`, `page_info.total=0`, and `data.items=[]`, causing the Management data sources page to display 0 authoritative sources instead of falling back to the `source-ingest` connector registry as an explicit degraded legacy projection.
root_cause.fix: Changed the v2 return condition to `if v2_sources is not None and len(v2_sources) > 0:` and tracked `v2_store_empty = v2_sources is not None and len(v2_sources) == 0 and client_error is None`. When `v2_store_empty` is True and the legacy `source-ingest` registry returns connectors (`source not in ("missing", "unavailable")` and `len(items) > 0`), `GET /bff/management/data-sources` now returns those connectors with `meta.status="degraded"`, `meta.source="legacy_projection"`, `data.status="degraded"`, `data.source="legacy_projection"`, and an explicit empty-store reason in `meta.degradation.reason`, `meta.reason`, `meta.surfaces.data_sources.reason`, `data.reason`, and `data.summary.reason`. Legacy projection rows are sanitized via `_sanitize_legacy_projection_row` so they never carry `allowed_actions`/`allowedActions` or inferred persona fleet status fields.

acceptance_criteria_verification.description: When the source management client is configured and returns zero instances without an error GET /bff/management/data-sources returns the source-ingest registry connectors as the explicit degraded legacy projection with meta status degraded and source legacy_projection and a reason naming the empty store and a test proves it with the real seven connector shape
When the store returns instances the response stays field for field identical to today and a test proves it
Client errors and an unconfigured client and an unavailable or empty legacy registry keep today's status and error and a test covers each
Legacy projection rows carry no allowed actions and no inferred persona fleet status so no command can be offered for them
No existing test is weakened or deleted to pass and any changed assertion is justified in evidence
acceptance_criteria_verification.changed_assertions_justification: No existing test assertions were changed, weakened, or deleted; only new tests covering the empty-v2 fallback contract were added.
